spec.description:
Fleet-level overview of all SNMP-monitored network devices. Aligns to the same metric naming and query patterns as the Network Device Detail dashboard.

Network lab dashboard (03). Interface bps uses ktranslate delta gauges: `(octets) * 8 / 60`.

Fleet tabs: Routing, Interfaces, Hardware, Resources, Events; drill links → ktranslate-device-details.

spec.title: Unhealthy Pollers
spec.description: Devices where ktranslate PollingHealth is not Healthy (1).

spec.title: SNMP Collectors
spec.description: Active ktranslate SNMP pollers (CHF heartbeat).

spec.title: Flow Collectors
spec.description: Active ktranslate NetFlow/sFlow collectors.

spec.title: Syslog Collectors
spec.description: Active ktranslate syslog collectors.

spec.title: Memory by Device
spec.description: Memory % from ktranslate MemoryUtilization (MemoryUsed + MemoryFree tags).

spec.title: Memory Utilization — Top 10
spec.description: Memory % trend for hottest devices.

spec.title: Top Interface Errors (fleet)
spec.description: Sum of in+out error counters per interface (delta gauge / 60s).

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (kentik_snmp_ifInErrors{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (kentik_snmp_ifOutErrors{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} / 60))

spec.title: Top Interface Utilization (bps)
spec.description: Highest combined in+out throughput per interface.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (kentik_snmp_ifHCInOctets{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_interface_name) (kentik_snmp_ifHCOutOctets{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 / 60))

spec.title: BGP Established % by Device
spec.description: Share of BGP peers in established state per device.

spec.title: BGP Peers Established
spec.description: Count of established BGP sessions fleet-wide.

spec.title: BGP Peers Total
spec.description: All BGP peers being polled.

spec.title: BGP Sessions Not Established
spec.description: Peers where ConnState is not established (string enum label).

spec.title: BGP Flaps (range)
spec.description: Peer flap counter increase over dashboard time range.

spec.title: Devices with Hardware Issues
spec.description: Count of devices with any chassis component not inService (2).

spec.title: Max Temperature by Device
spec.description: Highest chassis/sensor temperature (°C) per device.

spec.title: Temperature Over Time
spec.description: Chassis temperature trend (top 10 devices).

spec.title: Non-inService Components
spec.description: Chassis FRUs in failed, outOfService, or diagnosing state (excludes empty slots).

spec.title: Collectors by Type
spec.description: CHF heartbeat series grouped by ktranslate service_name prefix.

spec.title: Total Interfaces
spec.description: IF-MIB interfaces polled fleet-wide.

spec.title: Admin-Up Interfaces
spec.description: Interfaces with ifAdminStatus != down.

spec.title: Oper-Up Interfaces
spec.description: Interfaces currently oper-up (ifOperStatus == 1).

spec.title: Recent Network Syslog
spec.description: ktranslate syslog stream — link/BGP/fault keywords.

spec.title: Recent SNMP Traps
spec.description: ktranslate trap OTLP logs (KSnmpTrap + standard trap OIDs).

spec.title: Trap Types (range)
spec.description: Count of trap-related log lines by trap keyword.

spec.title: WAN Traffic by Interface
spec.description: Interfaces with ifAlias matching .*WAN.* (SRL interface description).

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_Alias, if_Description) (kentik_snmp_ifHCInOctets{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_Alias, if_Description) (kentik_snmp_ifHCOutOctets{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60))

spec.title: WAN Traffic Over Time
spec.description: Stacked bps on WAN-tagged interfaces.

spec.expr: sum by(device_name, if_Alias) (kentik_snmp_ifHCInOctets{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_Alias) (kentik_snmp_ifHCOutOctets{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60)

spec.title: Non-OK Fans
spec.description: Chassis fans not deviceStateInService (TIMETRA tmnxPhysChassisFan).

spec.title: Non-OK Power Supplies
spec.description: PSUs in failed, outOfService, or degraded state.

spec.title: Fan Issues
spec.description: Fans not in service — Device, slot, oper status.

spec.title: Power Supply Issues
spec.description: PSUs not online or not equipped.

spec.title: Devices by Provider
spec.description: Unique devices grouped by ktranslate SNMP profile provider label.

spec.title: Devices by Model
spec.description: Unique devices grouped by tags_kentik_model (platform category).

spec.title: Devices by Poller
spec.description: Unique devices grouped by ktranslate service_name (SNMP collector).

spec.title: SNMP Trap Volume
spec.description: Count of SNMP-trap-like log lines per interval, matched by keyword, from the combined ktranslate log stream.

spec.title: Active Network Alerts
spec.description: Firing alert instances from Network Lab / ktranslate rule group.

spec.title: Traffic Out — Top 10 Devices (Stacked)
spec.description:
Outbound traffic (bps) over time for the top 10 devices by volume

Interface bps assumes ktranslate delta gauges with a 60s SNMP poll (octets × 8 / 60). When poll_duration_sec is absent, 60s is assumed.

spec.title: Traffic In — Top 10 Devices (Stacked)
spec.description: Highest inbound bps per device (ktranslate delta gauge / 60s).

spec.title: Syslog Volume by Severity
spec.description: Count of syslog lines per interval, broken out by RFC5424 severity (parsed from the syslog JSON payload).

spec.title: Device Status
spec.description: Per-device snapshot: CPU, interface up/down counts, and traffic. Click Device to open detail view.

spec.expr: max by(device_name, provider) (100 * last_over_time(kentik_snmp_MemoryUsed{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}[1h])) / on(device_name, provider) (max by(device_name, provider) (last_over_time(kentik_snmp_MemoryUsed{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}[1h])) + max by(device_name, provider) (last_over_time(kentik_snmp_MemoryAvailable{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}[1h])))

spec.title: Interfaces Down by Device
spec.description: Count of oper-down interfaces per device — high counts may indicate trunk failures or decommissioned ports

spec.title: Interface Up % by Device
spec.description: Percentage of interfaces in oper-up state per device. Low values flag bulk failures or decommissioned port blocks.

spec.title: Current CPU by Device
spec.description: Current CPU % per device, sorted descending

spec.title: CPU Utilization — Top 10 Devices
spec.description: CPU utilization over time for the top 10 busiest devices

spec.title: Total Fleet Traffic by Device (Stacked)
spec.description:
Combined in+out traffic per device, stacked — use to identify which devices are driving aggregate spikes.

Interface bps assumes ktranslate delta gauges with a 60s SNMP poll (octets × 8 / 60). When poll_duration_sec is absent, 60s is assumed.

spec.title: Total Devices
spec.description: Unique devices reporting SNMP polling health

spec.title: Interfaces Down
spec.description: Count of interfaces currently in oper-down state across all devices

spec.title: Avg Fleet CPU
spec.description: Average of each device's max CPU — high values indicate broad fleet saturation

spec.title: Total Fleet Traffic
spec.description:
Sum of inbound + outbound bits/sec across all device interfaces

Interface bps assumes ktranslate delta gauges with a 60s SNMP poll (octets × 8 / 60). When poll_duration_sec is absent, 60s is assumed.

spec.title: Total Devices Δ 24h
spec.description: Absolute change in reporting devices vs 24h ago. Negative means devices stopped polling.

spec.expr:
count(count by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_PollingHealth{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
- (
  count(count by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_PollingHealth{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h))
  or
  count(count by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_PollingHealth{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
)

spec.title: Interfaces Down Δ 24h
spec.description: Absolute change in fleet-wide down interface count vs 24h ago. Positive = more outages.

spec.expr:
(count(kentik_snmp_if_OperStatus{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_AdminStatus!="down"} == 2) or vector(0))
- (
  (count(kentik_snmp_if_OperStatus{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_AdminStatus!="down"} offset 24h == 2) or vector(0))
  or
  (count(kentik_snmp_if_OperStatus{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_AdminStatus!="down"} == 2) or vector(0))
)

spec.title: Avg Fleet CPU Δ 24h
spec.description: Change in average fleet CPU vs 24h ago. Positive = fleet is busier than yesterday.

spec.expr:
avg(max by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_CPU{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
- (
  avg(max by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_CPU{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h))
  or
  avg(max by(device_name) (kentik_snmp_CPU{provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
)

spec.title: Fleet Traffic Δ 24h
spec.description:
Change in total fleet traffic (bps) vs 24h ago. Zero indicates no change or data unavailable.

Interface bps assumes ktranslate delta gauges with a 60s SNMP poll (octets × 8 / 60). When poll_duration_sec is absent, 60s is assumed.

spec.title: 03. Network Device Summary
